english.title: Licensor/pub operating business fail to maintain and retain packaging waste records - England
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a producer subject to the data collection obligations of a

(A)_[licensor]_
(B)_[pub operating business]_

in relation to packaging specified in the Packaging Waste (Data Reporting) (England) Regulations 2023, namely **(..SPECIFY PACKAGING..), failed to maintain for the data collection period of **(..SPECIFY PERIOD..), and retain for at least 7 years after the end of that period, records of information listed in paragraph

(C)_[22]_
(D)_[23(3)]_

of Schedule 1 to those regulations, namely **(..SPECIFY INFORMATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 16(6) and 28(2)(a) and (7) of the Packaging Waste (Data Reporting) (England) Regulations 2023.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: SI 2024/359 extended the records of information covered by this offence meaning this offence should not be used after the 31st March 2024. For the offence applying after this date, see H101648.
